# What we need from you: Larkspur Ceramics

Please send these by 16 October 2026. Anything you cannot send, tell us and we will work around it.

## Send us
1. (C-1) Two or three recent purchase orders exactly as they arrived, and the order sheet for September, so we can count a normal week.
2. (C-2) The steps you follow on Mondays to correct the product codes, if they are written down.
3. (C-5) A budget range for this work, or a note that we are building the case for one.
4. (C-6) Who signs off on spending, and up to what amount without the owner.

## Access we ask for (read-only)
1. (C-3) QuickBooks Online: a read-only view of a sandbox copy with your items, customers and invoices. Read-only, please; we will ask you to remove it when the plan is delivered.

## Workshops
1. Wednesday 14 October 2026, one hour: how an order travels from the email to the invoice, including the Monday code fixes and how long the typing takes (C-4). Who should come: the order coordinator and the operations manager.
